# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-11-10

- First stable release. No change to the endpoint, tools or OAuth scopes.
- Verified against Google's Drive MCP server (`https://drivemcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1`): 8 tools, scopes `drive.readonly` and `drive.file`.
- Google still labels the server Developer Preview, so its tools may change.

## 0.7.0 - 2026-10-29

- Updated plugin version for marketplace release.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-10-26

- First version: Google Drive remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
